exposure: Chromosome 1p32p31 deletion syndrome (13.2 Mb deletion at 1p31.3p32.2)
cohort: A single patient diagnosed with a 13.2 Mb deletion at 1p31.3p32.2, characteristic of chromosome 1p32p31 deletion syndrome.
finding: This patient represents the second reported case of Moyamoya disease and the first reported case of bilateral incomplete hippocampal inversion associated with chromosome 1p32p31 deletion syndrome.
